title: Minuta 2025-11-06
summary: The minutes of the 6 November meeting (25bp cut to 7.25%, 4-1 with Heath dissenting for a hold) show a Board more divided on the path than the communique suggests. Three members still argue for gradual easing: one says the real ex-ante rate (3.36%, upper end of the neutral range) 'debe adentrarse en dicho intervalo', another that the Fed's cut allows lowering the rate 'sin seguir comprimiendo el diferencial', a third that past restriction will keep operating even with cuts. But beyond Heath, who wants the guidance to stop signaling any further reduction and a commitment to the 3% point target, a second member who voted for the cut says the persistent core and upside risks 'sugiere mantener mayor cautela' and that the guidance must be modified for flexibility, so on the next step the Board is closer to 3-2. Versus the September minutes, where four of five backed continuing the cycle with more cuts as the base case, the easing camp has shrunk and the neutral-rate constraint is binding; versus this meeting's communique, the minutes read somewhat less dovish because they expose the second cautious voice.

key_quotes.quote: hacia delante la tasa real debe adentrarse en dicho intervalo.
key_quotes.context: A dovish member wants the real rate to move inside the neutral range, i.e. further cuts

key_quotes.quote: Externó que este panorama sugiere mantener mayor cautela hacia delante.
key_quotes.context: A member who voted for the cut asks for more caution and a modified guidance -- the second brake besides Heath

key_quotes.quote: Todos consideraron que el balance de riesgos respecto de la trayectoria prevista para la inflación en el horizonte de pronóstico mantiene un sesgo al alza.
key_quotes.context: Unanimous upside tilt to inflation risks, though the majority says it is less pronounced than in 2021-2024

key_quotes.quote: nuestra guía prospectiva debe dejar de señalizar una reducción adicional en la tasa objetivo.
key_quotes.context: Heath's dissent: stop signaling further cuts absent clear evidence of convergence
